title: Hybrid Job Optimization
description: Ask which prod jobs waste capacity or money, and why, using system tables plus Watchtower driver logs.

tables.description: One row per prod job over the last 30 days: list cost, DBUs, runs, failed runs, spend on failed runs, avg minutes, clusters per run, worker CPU/memory/swap, OOM/spill/lost-executor/error counts from logs, category (fix type), top_recommendation, fix_effort, est_monthly_savings_usd, est_annual_savings_usd and priority_rank (1 = do first).
Append-only daily snapshot per job (snapshot_date): cost, utilization, log signals and run health. Use for trends and before/after comparisons of a change.
Daily DBUs and list cost (USD) per job_id. Join to v_job_scorecard_latest on job_id for job_name. Use for cost growth and trend questions.
Per job per day: oom_events, spill_events, lost_executor_events, error_lines and runs_with_logs, parsed from driver logs by Watchtower.
Per job per day: worker-node avg_cpu, p95_cpu, avg_mem, max_swap (percent) and number of clusters.
Parsed driver log lines from Watchtower: cluster_id, log_source (stdout/stderr/log4j), log_level, log_ts, log_msg. Join to ops.v_job_cluster_map on cluster_id to get job_id and job_run_id.
Maps cluster_id to job_id and job_run_id (last 90 days).

instructions: All data is from the prod workspace. Costs are list price in USD, not the negotiated rate; say so when you report money.
est_monthly_savings_usd and est_annual_savings_usd are conservative estimates, not guaranteed savings. Call them 'estimated'.
category is the fix type: MEMORY, SPILL, LOST_EXECUTORS, FAILING, MULTI_CLUSTER, OVERSIZED, CPU_BOUND or OK. Use top_recommendation to explain it in plain words.
priority_rank orders the work: 1 is the job to fix first. Jobs with category OK have no rank.
CPU and memory are worker-node percentages. p95_cpu below 40 with avg_mem below 50 means the cluster is oversized.
oom_events, spill_events and lost_executor_events come from driver logs parsed by Watchtower.
Show job_name, not job_id. Round money to whole dollars. 'Last month' means the last 30 days.
For trends over time, or comparing before and after a change, use job_daily_history.
To show log lines for a job, join silver.logs to ops.v_job_cluster_map on cluster_id, filter by the job's job_id from v_job_scorecard_latest.
sample_questions: How much did our prod jobs cost in the last 30 days, and how much can we save per month and per year?
What are the top 10 fixes to do first, with estimated monthly savings and effort?
Which quick wins (low effort) save the most money?
How much money did we waste on failed runs last month, and which jobs caused it?
Which jobs are oversized, and how much would right-sizing save?
Which jobs are running out of memory, and what should we change?
Show estimated savings by fix type.
Which jobs start more than one cluster per run?
Which jobs' cost grew the most in the last 30 days compared with the 30 days before?
Show the daily cost trend for the most expensive job over the last 90 days.
